descriptions.w3d_d32e_build_state_stream_801a9478: Builds the render state stream of a mesh: counts three words per attribute across the group list, locks the output array, then for each attribute writes the looked-up table entry for each of its three bit-field keys only when the key changed, followed by its value; shrinks the array to the words written, clears the dirty flag at +284 and returns the output object.
